corrections.text: The article describes Qt StyleKit, under 'Styling, models and networking', without noting its status. The Qt blog places it under the heading 'StyleKit Is Available in Labs: Try It Out', meaning it is offered through Qt Labs for trial rather than as a supported Qt 6.12 module.

The article quotes Qt as saying Qt 6.12 'is built to meet the requirements set by the CRA'. The Qt blog makes the compliance statement about the commercial Qt 6.12 LTS, and adds that the CRA Declaration of Conformity does not make a product automatically CRA-compliant; developers still have to do their own CRA work.
